settings.heading: Details & care
settings.content:
• Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors.
  • Use a gentle cycle and mild detergent. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.
  • Lay flat or hang to dry. Do not tumble dry.
  • Do not iron, dry clean or wash with abrasive items (zippers, Velcro).

Designed and made in Colombia with our own fabrics.
